content.title: TINY HABITS THAT QUIETLY TRANSFORM YOUR {{HEALTH}}
facts: Drink a glass of **water with lemon and a pinch of sea salt** right after waking — it **rehydrates** your cells and kickstarts digestion after hours of sleep.
Take a **10-minute walk right after meals** — it blunts **blood sugar spikes** and speeds up digestion noticeably.
Step outside for **5 minutes of morning sunlight** — it resets your **circadian rhythm** and supports steady mood through the day.
Stir **one tablespoon of ground flaxseed** into breakfast — the **fiber and omega-3 ALA** support heart and gut health long-term.
Spend **2 minutes on slow, deep breathing** before bed — it lowers **cortisol** and helps you fall into deeper sleep faster.
Swap one daily coffee for **green tea** — its **L-theanine** smooths out energy and avoids the afternoon crash.
